# macOS acceptance and safety boundary

<!-- Generated by tools/repository-check.mjs; edit docs/status/acceptance.json. -->

Current macOS distribution is arm64; default Modem behavior remains disabled (PC/SC-only).
The Go installer supports a per-user LaunchAgent. Universal/notarized builds, multi-Modem and cross-vendor acceptance remain separate work.
Historical claims and original detailed safety requirements are preserved in [the archived plan](docs/archive/2026-09-20/TODO_MACOS_AGENT.md), not current deployment instructions.

| Criterion | Implementation | Acceptance | Original requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| [MAC01](docs/status/README.md#mac01) | implemented | pending_hardware | 复用现有 SMS/Call 领域合约已验证列表与状态读取；本轮未重复发送收费短信、未拨号，也未重做   来电接听，因此发送/接收/通话端到端保持待人工授权验收。任何 unknown 均不自动重试。 |
| [MAC02](docs/status/README.md#mac02) | partial | pending_product | universal、公证与 CI release 尚未完成；当前 Developer ID 签名不能冒充已 notarize。 |
| [MAC03](docs/status/README.md#mac03) | needs_verification | pending_hardware | runtime snapshot、配置、控制 session、数据 backend 与设备列表已由单数 `modem` 改为按   `ModemInstanceIdentity` 索引的集合；至少 2 个 Modem 同时在线，分别插拔、换卡、断线和恢复时   互不影响仍缺第二台物理 Modem 验证。首个 PoC 的单 Modem 限制不得泄漏进公共领域合约。 |
| [MAC04](docs/status/README.md#mac04) | needs_verification | pending_hardware | 至少当前 EC20+多 PC/SC Mac 与另一品牌/协议 Modem 交叉验证；没有第二种硬件时只能标注已验   型号，不宣称通用 4G/5G 数据已完成，也不能把“可实例化”写成“多 Modem 已验收”。 |
